model_en: A Federation Forces plan to develop mobile
desc_en: suits to counter Zeon. Its aim was to build prototypes - the support-type Guntank and Guncannon and the general-purpose Gundam - and run operational tests toward mass production. In practice, it was completed once GM mass production got on track.

model_en: The Fed. Forces' first major counterattack
desc_en: of the One Year War. Seizing on Garma Zabi's death in N. America, they planned to retake Odessa in Europe, Zeon's most vital base left on Earth. Aided by White Base, the Federation won, and from then on Zeon's ground forces were in dire straits.

desc_en: a powerful mega particle cannon to attack Fed. bases. Led by Ginius Sakhalin, research and tests took place in Asia. After trials of the test units Apsaras I and II, Apsaras III wiped out a Fed. base in combat, but was destroyed by the Ez8.

desc_en: Delaz Fleet, a Zeon remnant force. It aimed to drop a colony on Earth to hit its food supply, making Earth more dependent on space for food and turning Federation eyes to space. The operation succeeded, but led to the rise of the Titans.

desc_en: destruction, but Haman's Axis still had ample forces left. Declaring the revival of Zeon, it renamed itself "Neo Zeon." The weakened Earth Federation and AEUG could not stop Neo Zeon's invasion, and war broke out once again, lasting about a year.
